screening_decisions.reason: Randomized double-blind trial comparing DDAVP to placebo in patients undergoing elective aortic operations. Patients had aneurysm or occlusive disease (not inherited bleeding disorders). Outcomes measured include blood loss and transfusion requirements. Meets all selection criteria.

Double-blinded randomized prospective study comparing desmopressin to placebo in patients undergoing elective total hip replacement. Meets selection criteria for RCT comparing DDAVP to placebo in surgical patients without inherited bleeding disorders.
This is a meta-analysis of 38 randomized trials, not a primary randomized controlled trial. The selection criteria specify inclusion of RCTs, not meta-analyses or systematic reviews.

Randomized trial comparing DDAVP to aprotinin (active comparator) and no treatment in patients undergoing cardiopulmonary bypass surgery. Meets selection criteria for RCT comparing DDAVP to active comparator in surgical patients.

Prospective randomized double-blinded placebo-controlled trial comparing desmopressin to placebo in CABG patients treated with aspirin. Meets selection criteria for RCT in surgical patients without inherited bleeding disorders.
Randomized trial comparing DDAVP to no DDAVP in patients undergoing bimaxillary osteotomy (orthognathic surgery). Patients had normal coagulation profiles. Meets selection criteria.

Prospective double-blind placebo-controlled randomized trial comparing desmopressin to placebo in patients undergoing elective cardiac surgery. Outcomes include blood loss and transfusion requirements. Meets selection criteria.

Randomized trial comparing DDAVP to saline in surgical patients receiving hydroxyethyl starch. While primary outcome is vWF activity, this is an RCT comparing DDAVP to placebo in surgical patients. Conservative approach to include for further review.
This is a clinical guidance document/summary, not a randomized controlled trial. Does not meet the study design requirement.
Double-blind randomized trial comparing desmopressin to placebo in patients undergoing total hip replacement. Patients had preoperative normal bleeding time. Meets selection criteria.

Double-blind placebo-controlled randomized trial comparing desmopressin to placebo in patients with excessive bleeding after cardiopulmonary bypass. Meets selection criteria for RCT in surgical patients.
Randomized trial comparing DDAVP to saline control in patients undergoing valvular heart surgery. Outcomes include blood loss and transfusion requirements. Meets selection criteria.

Prospective randomized controlled trial comparing intranasal desmopressin to blood transfusion in cirrhotic patients undergoing dental extraction. Cirrhosis causes acquired (not inherited) coagulopathy. Conservative approach to include for further review as it tests DDAVP for bleeding in invasive procedure.
Double-blind randomized trial comparing desmopressin to placebo in patients undergoing total hip or knee arthroplasty. Patients were hemostatically normal. Meets selection criteria.

Study comparing desmopressin to no desmopressin in patients treated with aspirin undergoing cholecystectomy. While small (12 patients), it appears to be a randomized comparison. Conservative approach to include for further review.
Randomized trial comparing desmopressin to saline in patients undergoing endoscopic sinus surgery. Outcomes include blood loss. Meets selection criteria.

Randomized double-blind trial comparing desmopressin to placebo in patients undergoing spinal fusion with Harrington rod instrumentation. Patients had normal hemostatic function. Meets selection criteria.
Double-blind randomized trial comparing DDAVP to saline placebo in cardiac surgery patients who had taken aspirin. Outcomes include blood loss and transfusion requirements. Meets selection criteria.

Double-blind randomized trial comparing aprotinin, desmopressin, and placebo in patients undergoing cardiopulmonary bypass. Meets selection criteria for RCT comparing DDAVP to active comparator and placebo.

Randomized double-blind trial comparing DDAVP to saline placebo in CABG patients. While primary focus is hemodynamic effects, blood loss was also measured. Conservative approach to include for further review.
Double-blind randomized prospective trial comparing DDAVP to placebo in patients undergoing cardiopulmonary bypass. Outcomes include blood loss and transfusion requirements. Meets selection criteria.

Double-blind randomized study comparing desmopressin to placebo in patients undergoing spinal fusion for neuromuscular scoliosis. Patients described as hemostatically normal. Meets selection criteria.
Randomized double-blind trial comparing desmopressin to placebo in routine coronary artery bypass surgery. Outcomes include blood loss and transfusion requirements. Meets selection criteria.
This is a systematic review with meta-analysis comparing transfusion strategies, not a primary randomized controlled trial of desmopressin. Does not meet study design or intervention criteria.
This is a methodological paper about meta-analysis techniques for detecting publication bias. Not a clinical trial and does not involve desmopressin. Does not meet any selection criteria.

This is a prospective, blinded, randomized controlled trial comparing DDAVP to placebo in patients undergoing cardiac surgery (CABG). The study examines blood loss and blood product replacement outcomes. Patients are adults without mentioned inherited bleeding disorders. Meets all selection criteria.

Double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial examining DDAVP effect on blood loss and red cell transfusion after coronary artery bypass surgery. Adult patients without mentioned inherited bleeding disorders. Meets selection criteria.

Double-blind, randomized study comparing DDAVP to placebo in cardiac surgery patients. Evaluates bleeding and replacement volume outcomes. Adult population without mentioned inherited bleeding disorders. Meets selection criteria.

This is a letter to editor discussing distress management during lumbar puncture procedures. It does not describe a randomized controlled trial of desmopressin for bleeding. The content is about sedation and analgesia, not desmopressin intervention. Does not meet selection criteria.

Randomized, blinded comparison of desmopressin vs saline placebo in pediatric patients undergoing cardiac surgery. Examines blood loss and blood replacement outcomes. Children without mentioned inherited bleeding disorders. Meets selection criteria (children are included per protocol).

Randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial examining DDAVP effects on bleeding after cardiac surgery with extracorporeal circulation. Adult patients without mentioned inherited bleeding disorders. Meets selection criteria.

This is a retrospective cohort study, not a randomized controlled trial. It examines outcomes in patients who declined blood transfusions for religious reasons. No desmopressin intervention is studied. Does not meet selection criteria.

Randomized double-blind trial evaluating desmopressin as a thromboprophylactic agent following percutaneous transcubital right heart catheterization (an invasive procedure). While the primary outcome is thrombosis rather than bleeding, this is an RCT of desmopressin in an invasive procedure setting in adults without mentioned inherited bleeding disorders. Conservative decision to include.

Double-blind randomized controlled trial comparing prebiopsy desmopressin acetate to placebo in patients undergoing kidney biopsy (invasive procedure). Examines bleeding complications as primary outcome. Adult patients with normal coagulation parameters (no inherited bleeding disorders). Meets selection criteria.
This is a clinical guideline document, not a randomized controlled trial. It provides guidance on von Willebrand disease diagnosis and management. Does not meet selection criteria.

Double-blind, randomized, prospective clinical trial examining desmopressin (deamino-8-D-arginin vasopressin) vs placebo in scoliosis surgery. Evaluates blood loss outcomes. Adult patients without mentioned inherited bleeding disorders. Meets selection criteria.

Randomized, double-blind trial comparing different doses of desmopressin to placebo in patients undergoing total hip arthroplasty. Examines blood loss and transfusion requirements. Rheumatoid arthritis is an autoimmune condition, not an inherited bleeding disorder. Meets selection criteria.

Based on the title, this appears to be a randomized controlled trial examining desmopressin for reducing blood transfusion during cardiac surgery in patients with aspirin-induced platelet dysfunction. Aspirin-induced dysfunction is acquired, not inherited. Meets selection criteria. Abstract is truncated but title indicates relevant RCT.
This is a review article summarizing current information on desmopressin efficacy and safety. It is not a randomized controlled trial. Does not meet selection criteria.

This appears to be a news brief or summary article (from nature.com) reporting findings rather than a primary RCT report. The data matches Study 34 (13.7% vs 30.5% bleeding). Likely a duplicate or secondary report. Does not meet selection criteria as a primary study.
This is a review article providing a synopsis of transfusion reactions. It is not a randomized controlled trial of desmopressin. Does not meet selection criteria.

Placebo-controlled, randomized clinical trial examining preoperative DDAVP infusion on blood loss in patients undergoing burn débridement and grafting surgery. Adult patients (mean age 33, range 12-70) without mentioned inherited bleeding disorders. Meets selection criteria.

Double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial comparing desmopressin to saline placebo in elective cardiac surgery patients. Examines postoperative blood loss and blood product replacement. Adult patients without mentioned inherited bleeding disorders. Meets selection criteria.
This is a national survey study of RBC utilization, not a randomized controlled trial. No desmopressin intervention is studied. Does not meet selection criteria.
This is an observational study using data from the Society of Thoracic Surgeons National Cardiac Database. It is not a randomized controlled trial of desmopressin. Does not meet selection criteria.
This is a clinical guideline document, not a randomized controlled trial. No desmopressin intervention is studied. Does not meet selection criteria.

Multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled parallel-group study examining desmopressin vs placebo in patients with active bleeding after cardiac surgery. Examines red blood cell transfusion requirements. Adult patients without mentioned inherited bleeding disorders. Meets selection criteria.
This is a methodological paper about detecting bias in meta-analyses using funnel plots. It is not a randomized controlled trial of desmopressin. Does not meet selection criteria.
This is a review paper discussing cellular mechanisms of desmopressin action. It is not a randomized controlled trial. Does not meet selection criteria.

Randomized, prospective, double-blind clinical trial comparing desmopressin to saline placebo in patients undergoing major flap reconstructive surgery. Examines intraoperative blood loss and transfusion requirements. Adult patients with spinal cord injury described as hemostatically normal (no inherited bleeding disorders). Meets selection criteria.
Randomised double-blind RCT comparing DDAVP to placebo in CABG patients without inherited bleeding disorders. Reports blood products transfused as outcome.
Study population has Bernard-Soulier syndrome, which is an inherited bleeding disorder. Protocol explicitly excludes patients with inherited bleeding disorders.
This is a clinical practice guideline document, not a randomised controlled trial. Does not meet study design criteria.
Study describes observational comparison of patient groups (with/without antiplatelet therapy, with/without desmopressin). No randomisation described in the abstract.
This is a clinical practice guideline update, not a randomised controlled trial. Does not meet study design criteria.
This is a meta-analysis of previous trials, not a primary randomised controlled trial. Does not meet study design criteria.
This is a meta-analysis of prophylactic drug treatments, not a primary randomised controlled trial. Does not meet study design criteria.
This is a review article discussing alternatives to platelet transfusion, not a randomised controlled trial. Does not meet study design criteria.

Prospective single-blind study comparing desmopressin to tranexamic acid (active comparator) in total knee replacement patients. Reports allogeneic blood transfusion as outcome. Conservative inclusion as study design appears to be controlled trial.
Study is prospective but not randomised - all patients received desmopressin with no control group. Does not meet study design criteria.

While this is an RCT in uremic patients, the outcomes measured are platelet function (closure time) and coagulation factors, not blood loss or transfusion requirements. Does not meet outcome criteria.
Study compares PFA-100 screening group to historical non-PFA group. This is an observational study, not a randomised controlled trial.
Prospective randomised double-blind RCT comparing desmopressin to placebo in children undergoing cardiac operations. Reports postoperative blood loss as outcome.
Randomised placebo-controlled RCT comparing desmopressin to placebo in total knee replacement patients. Reports allogeneic blood transfusion as outcome.
Double-blinded placebo-controlled RCT comparing desmopressin to placebo in adult cardiac surgery patients. Reports blood loss and transfusion requirements as outcomes.
This is a pharmacokinetics study examining routes of administration and haematological effects, not a randomised controlled trial comparing DDAVP to control in surgical patients.
Randomised controlled double-blind RCT comparing desmopressin to placebo in patients undergoing hepatectomy. Reports blood loss and transfusion requirements as outcomes.
Duplicate of study 62 - observational comparison of PFA-100 screening group to historical controls. Not a randomised controlled trial.
Double-blinded randomised RCT comparing desmopressin to placebo and tranexamic acid in cardiac surgery patients. Reports blood loss and transfusion as outcomes.
Double-blind prospective randomised RCT comparing desmopressin to placebo in cardiac surgery patients. Reports blood loss as outcome.
Randomised trial comparing desmopressin to placebo in cardiac surgery patients. Reports blood loss and blood component therapy as outcomes.
Randomised double-blinded RCT comparing desmopressin to placebo in CABG patients. Reports postoperative blood loss as outcome.
Prospective randomised RCT comparing desmopressin alone to desmopressin plus tranexamic acid in CABG patients. Reports blood loss and transfusion as outcomes.
This is a systematic review and meta-analysis of tranexamic acid, not a primary RCT of desmopressin. Does not meet study design or intervention criteria.
This is a consensus paper based on literature review and expert discussion, not a randomised controlled trial. Does not meet study design criteria.

This is a review article summarizing clinical indications for desmopressin, not a primary randomized controlled trial. The selection criteria require RCTs comparing DDAVP to placebo or active comparator.

This is a prospective, placebo-controlled, double-blinded RCT comparing desmopressin to placebo in patients undergoing CABG. The population consists of patients taking anti-platelet medicine (not inherited bleeding disorders), and outcomes include blood loss and transfusion requirements.

This study compares desmopressin to a control group in lumbar fusion surgery, measuring blood loss and transfusion requirements. While randomization is not explicitly stated in the abstract, the conservative approach warrants inclusion to verify at full-text review.
This article discusses Cochrane review methodology and is not a clinical trial on desmopressin. It does not meet any of the selection criteria.
This is a systematic review about transjugular liver biopsy techniques, not a clinical trial on desmopressin. It does not address the review question.

This is a case series of 4 children with adverse events (hyponatremia and seizures) after DDAVP administration. It is not a randomized controlled trial comparing DDAVP to placebo or active comparator.

This is a prospective, randomized, placebo-controlled, double-blind RCT comparing desmopressin to placebo in patients undergoing valvular heart operations. Outcomes include blood loss and transfusion requirements in patients without inherited bleeding disorders.
This is a meta-analysis of randomized trials, not a primary RCT. The selection criteria require primary randomized controlled trials, not secondary analyses.

This is a double-blind, randomized placebo-controlled RCT comparing desmopressin to placebo in patients undergoing aortic valve replacement. The population has acquired platelet dysfunction from aortic valve stenosis (not inherited bleeding disorders), and outcomes include blood loss.

This is a double-blind, placebo-controlled RCT comparing desmopressin to placebo in patients undergoing aorto-iliac graft surgery. Outcomes include blood loss and transfusion requirements in patients without inherited bleeding disorders.

This is a prospective, double-blind RCT with random allocation comparing DDAVP to placebo in healthy young patients undergoing spinal fusion for idiopathic scoliosis. Outcomes include blood loss measurements.

This is a prospective, randomized, double-blind RCT comparing desmopressin to placebo in patients undergoing complex congenital heart operations. The population does not have inherited bleeding disorders, and outcomes include blood loss and transfusion requirements.
This is a review article about von Willebrand's disease, an inherited bleeding disorder. The review objective specifically excludes people with inherited bleeding disorders, and this is not an RCT.
This is a clinical practice guideline document, not a randomized controlled trial. It does not meet the study design criteria.

This is a prospective randomized double-blind, placebo-controlled RCT comparing desmopressin to placebo in patients undergoing CABG. The population includes patients with normal and abnormal platelet-fibrinogen function (not inherited bleeding disorders), and outcomes include blood loss and transfusion requirements.

This is a phase II dose-escalation trial focused on safety and dose selection for cancer metastasis prevention, not a randomized controlled trial comparing DDAVP to placebo for reducing perioperative blood loss/transfusion. The primary endpoint is safety, not blood loss.

This is a randomized RCT comparing desmopressin to control in patients undergoing coronary artery bypass grafting. The population consists of patients without bleeding disorders, and outcomes include blood loss and transfusion requirements.
This is a meta-analysis of 17 randomized trials, not a primary RCT. The selection criteria require primary randomized controlled trials, not secondary analyses.

This is a double-blind, randomized, prospective RCT comparing DDAVP to placebo in patients undergoing cardiac surgery with cardiopulmonary bypass. Outcomes include blood loss and transfusion requirements in patients without inherited bleeding disorders.

This is a prospective, randomized, placebo-controlled, double-blind RCT comparing desmopressin to placebo in patients receiving aspirin before CABG. The population does not have inherited bleeding disorders, and outcomes include blood loss and transfusion requirements.

This is a non-randomized controlled study. Patients were divided into consecutive groups (100 control, then 100 treatment), not randomly allocated. The selection criteria require randomized controlled trials.

This is a randomized, double-blind prospective RCT comparing desmopressin to placebo in patients undergoing total hip replacement. Outcomes include bleeding time and coagulation parameters in patients without inherited bleeding disorders.

This is a prospective randomized RCT comparing DDAVP to placebo in patients undergoing coronary artery bypass grafting. The population consists of patients without bleeding disorders, and outcomes include blood loss and transfusion requirements.

This is a randomized, double-blinded, placebo-controlled RCT comparing DDAVP to placebo in children with severe cerebral palsy undergoing spinal fusion. The population does not have inherited bleeding disorders, and outcomes include blood loss and transfusion requirements.
This is a meta-analysis of 72 randomized trials, not a primary RCT. The selection criteria require primary randomized controlled trials, not secondary analyses.
